title: Tensor scalar comparison in normalized total-limit coordinates
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W with l invertible, derived system calculi SE,SL, normalized Roos models rhoE,rhoL, normalized scalar model SY and tensor models TE,TL [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]. For integral constructible M,N and a completeness proof for their completed E tensor, compose scalarTensorCompleted with TL.realization and total limit of the system tensor of the two scalarReduction maps. This equals SY.realization at the completed E tensor followed by total limit of sequence scalar applied to tensorReduction_E, then derivedSigma. This equation is in the completed-coefficient derived category; it does not assert the pullback equation or construct realization models.

proof.text: Apply the canonical uniqueness witness for derivedSigma to obtain its DerivedSigmaModel equation. Then apply the strict-to-limit transport theorem to the supplied tensor and scalar realization models; this theorem isolates the localization and total-limit passage from the strict normalized cochain equation.

theorem scalarTowerTensorLimitSquare (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (ρE : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l E W)
    (ρL : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l L W)
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι W SE ρL)
    (TE : TensorModel l E W SE ρE) (TL : TensorModel l L W SL ρL)
    (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E W)
    (hT : IsSfDerivedComplete l E W
      ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj))) :
    (scalarTensorCompleted l E L ι W M.obj N.obj M.property.1 N.property.1 hT).hom ≫
        TL.realization.hom.app
          ((integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj M.obj,
            (integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj N.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          (SL.systemClosed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY M.obj)
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY N.obj))) =
      SY.realization.hom.app
          ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).map
            (tensorReduction l E W SE ρE TE M.obj N.obj) ≫
          (derivedSigma l E L ι W SE SL).hom.app
            (SE.reduction.obj M.obj, SE.reduction.obj N.obj))
